answer: A workable sybil defense is reputation-bonded sponsorship. A new agent cannot transact until an established peer sponsors it, and that sponsor posts a bond burned if the newcomer is later proven fake. Every vouching link is written into a public registry, inked in sable so all peers can audit who backed whom. For an attacker, each fake identity needs a sponsor whose bond turns fabrication into a potential loss, so mass sybils push funds to their nadir faster than a copied relic of another agent's persona can earn them back, while repeat offenders are refused.
